### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 550f4cc2fd594f5965ef9b12da38538064ea9c9b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `58964c03f6848ba0c957d9483a50dd1a26baa9fb` — the merge of head `3fa9e55aed6c834ce67c47a7c571b04ffa1e5187` into base `550f4cc2fd594f5965ef9b12da38538064ea9c9b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 58964c03f6848ba0c957d9483a50dd1a26baa9fb && git checkout 58964c03f6848ba0c957d9483a50dd1a26baa9fb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 550f4cc2fd594f5965ef9b12da38538064ea9c9b 3fa9e55aed6c834ce67c47a7c571b04ffa1e5187 && git checkout -B drift-repro 550f4cc2fd594f5965ef9b12da38538064ea9c9b && git merge --no-ff 3fa9e55aed6c834ce67c47a7c571b04ffa1e5187

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 550f4cc2fd594f5965ef9b12da38538064ea9c9b
```

</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3fa9e55aed6c834ce67c47a7c571b04ffa1e5187`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read, and nothing else: card #21500's body and all 8 comments (grade `5963870066`, engine claim `5963933235`, engine report `5964183876` and release `5964198571`, the re-route and ruling `5964333435` with Q1 A and Q2 A, claim `5964654984`, dev report `5965453403`, seat answer `5965506932`); PR #21535's body as patched by the seat, its 22-file list and the net diff against `main` at `550f4cc2fd`; the check-runs on the head, read twice; the probe at `142dfcbcaa` and `bf6401f286`; cards #21537 and objectstack-ai/objectui#11539. Files at refs were read with `git show`; no worktree, build, test, gate or ablation was run.

1. **Accept set: unchanged — right.** `ViewSchema`, `FormViewSchema` and `ObjectListViewSchema` are untouched; at the head `form` is still described as the default form view and `formViews` as additional named form views (`view.zod.ts` about `:4760`). No authorable key is added, removed or renamed, no generated artifact is in the diff, and the dev's `check:generated` reading is 15 of 15 current.
2. **Public surface: unchanged — right.** `expandViewContainer` / `expandViewContainerWithDiagnostics` keep their signatures and `ExpandedViewItem` keeps `isDefault?: boolean`. The deleted `viewSignature` and the new `listViewBody` are both module-private: a grep of the base and the head finds no other user. Nothing the pinned objectui imports is removed, so the skipped Console Pin Gate is the right reading.
3. **Form family with `form` present — right.** The `formSigSeen` collapse is gone; the container's `form` is always served as `OBJECT.form`, flagged `isDefault`, and is the only form item flagged; a named form whose body equals `form` stays named. This is ruling Q1 A executed, pinned in `packages/spec/src/ui/view-container-default-form.test.ts` (the HotCRM collision shape and the equal-body named form) and at the door by the probe.
4. **Form family with `form` absent — right.** The `out[formStart]` promotion is gone; no form item carries `isDefault` (no key, the list family's own not-default spelling). This is ruling Q2 A executed, and it matches the schema's text. Pinned, with the list default shown untouched.
5. **List family, folded in — right.** The `{ type, label, columns }` signature let a same-signature named list with a different body (a filter, a sort) displace the default `list`. The collapse now fires only on a whole-body restatement, keys sorted at every depth, the list's own `name` aside. That is exactly the ruling's trigger, a named list with a different body, and it keeps the measured app-crm producer: the `metadata` `view-expand.test.ts` pin's `list` and `listViews.all` are whole-body equal in another key order and still collapse. The dev's flagged deviation from a literal never-collapse is not a deviation from the ruling, which prescribed never-collapse for forms only. The side effect, a default list that used to collapse into a different-body named list now claiming `OBJECT.default`, is named in the changeset. Right.
6. **Unchanged and declared:** with no `list`, the first named list is still flagged default. The docblock now states it. It is outside the ruling and asymmetric with the form rule; not wrong here and not hidden. No action owed by this PR.
7. **The `form.name` key branch — right to leave.** `FormViewSchema` is a `strictObject` with no top-level `name` (its keys enumerated at the head, about `:4162` to `:4460`), so the branch is unreachable for schema-valid metadata. It adds nothing to the accept set, and the seat recorded it in the acceptance notes.
8. **Example migrations, 7 containers, each read against its own text — right.** Verified at the head: `crm_activity` and `crm_opportunity` (`formViews.default`, the only form) move to `form`; `crm_lead`'s `default` moves to `form` and `web_to_lead` stays named (docblock: PUBLIC / ANONYMOUS, served at `/forms/contact-us`); showcase `business_unit`, `project` and `task` (`edit`, each commented as the stand-in for a colliding `default` key) move to `form`; `showcase_inquiry` (only `formViews.contact`, `allowAnonymous` plus `publicLink`) stays named with no default, source unchanged; `showcase_contact` already authors `form` beside `formViews.create`, source unchanged and now served as `create-vs-edit-form.mdx` describes. The count of 11 in-repo `defineView` containers holds (13 hits at the head, two of them in translation comments).
9. **Identity moves — right.** `showcase_task.edit` becomes `showcase_task.form` in two actions, the Overview CTA, `actions.test.ts` and two platform-checklist strings. A head-wide grep finds no stale reference to the moved identities outside self-contained test fixtures; `packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.test.ts:66` declares its own `formViews.edit` and still exercises by-name resolution, which this change does not alter. Right to leave.
10. **Tests widened — right.** `examples/app-crm/test/i18n-sections.test.ts` now walks `form`; without it 8 of 9 sections would have left coverage silently and the non-vacuity floor of 9 would have read 1. `collectFormViewTypes` now counts `form.type`, symmetric with the list collector. The comment-only edits in `cli`, `lint`, `objectql` and the codemod restate the rule; their fixtures and assertions are unchanged.
11. **Docs — right.** `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` taught a container whose only form was `formViews.edit`, which after this change declares no default; it now teaches `form` as the default and `formViews` as forms served by name. The other hand-written pages that author `formViews` (`forms.mdx` about `:64`, `:286`, `:333`; `public-data-collection.mdx` about `:18`) teach named forms reached by a public link or `/_console/forms/NAME`, so none is made false and none needed an edit.
12. **Probe carried unchanged — right.** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/view-container-default-form.dogfood.test.ts` at the head is byte-identical to `bf6401f286`; `142dfcbcaa` differs from it only by the manifest-id fix the engine seat made. The commit shas differ by cherry-pick onto `88fb5e85a0`; the content does not, which is what the ruling's acceptance names.
13. **Consumers — right.** Every registrar reaches the one function (`metadata/plugin.ts`, `metadata/view-container-expansion.ts`, `objectql/engine.ts`, `metadata-protocol/protocol.ts` at two sites), so the overlay door runs the changed code. No objectstack non-test source reads `isDefault` on a form item (`cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:365` reads lists only). No serve-path, `objectql`, `metadata-protocol` or console change, as the ruling bars.
14. **Gates, as they stand on the head** (41 check-runs, 0 failed). Required: Build Core, Dogfood Regression Gate and its 3 shards, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Governed Surface Queue Guard, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace, Test Core 2/6 through 6/6: success. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Test Core (1/6)`: in_progress at the second read, an honest in-progress reading and not a pass; the landing waits on them whatever this record says. Console Pin Gate: skipped, correctly (item 2). The probe runs inside `@objectstack/dogfood`, which the green Dogfood Regression Gate executes, so the door-level acceptance is CI-measured on this head, not only dev-reported.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/21500-spec-view-container-default-form.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **`patch`** — right. A bug fix in a released package takes a patch; the expansion is corrected to the behaviour `ViewSchema` already declares, and no authorable key, export or accept set widens or narrows, so neither `minor` nor a breaking `(narrowing)` applies. The body carries the author-facing FROM → TO migration (`formViews: { edit: … }` becomes `form: { … }`; a reference to `OBJECT.edit` becomes `OBJECT.form`) and names all three behaviour changes, the list-family one included, which is what the ruling asked of the changeset.
- The example apps (`@objectstack/example-crm`, `@objectstack/example-showcase`) and `@objectstack/dogfood` are `private: true` at the head: no changeset owed. `skip-changeset` is rightly not used.
- `Clause-②: no`, no direction arm, on line 2 of the PR body and in the changeset body — right. The line answers whether the card widens an accept set or expands a public surface; nothing here does either. The gates agree on the dev's run: `check-changeset-no-major` (no major bump; declares clause-② `no`), `check-adr-0087-registration` (1 non-breaking changeset), `check-empty-changeset` (1 declaring changeset). No ADR-0087 disposition marker is owed because nothing is breaking.

### ③ Boundary flags

**The ruling's acceptance (`5964333435`):**
- Door probe green on the HotCRM shape, the two-form shape and the `crm_account` control: dev 3 of 3 at the head; CI's Dogfood Regression Gate is green on the head. Met.
- Overlay re-measure: done on the unscoped kernel at `78f36c0ebb`, whose form family is byte-identical to the head. The HotCRM-shape overlay of the packaged `crm_contact` serves one `isDefault`, the overlay's own `form`; an overlay that omits `form` keeps the packaged `OBJECT.form` as the one default. One default each time, so the ruling's file-a-finding condition (two defaults) did not arise, and the seat recorded it clean (`5965506932`, item 3). `env_local` was NOT MEASURED on this head (the session's permission policy refused the CLI standalone-stack fixture); accepted because this diff touches no serve path and the engine seat measured the two kernels identical item for item on every row (`5964183876`). Answered, with the gap declared rather than hidden.
- The changeset names the behaviour change for authors who relied on first-named promotion. Met (section ②).

**Dev deviations (`5965453403`), one line each:**
1. List family whole-body rather than literal never-collapse: ruling-conformant, item ①.5.
2. Probe commits cherry-picked under new shas: content byte-identical, item ①.12.
3. A6 `env_local` NOT MEASURED: answered above.
4. Migration beyond the 7 containers (task form identity, i18n test, coverage collector, `views.mdx`): each a necessary companion of the move, items ①.9 to ①.11.
5. Commit trailers kept model-free: commit messages are not among this review's inputs and are not judged here; the pre-push hook is their gate.
6. Stale tree, 6 behind `origin/main` at `550f4cc2fd`: the PR reads `mergeable: true`; the two moved gate-config files (the prose-id baseline and the engine-double pin list) are fed by nothing in this diff; CI judges the merge ref, and `Lint & Repo Gates` is the gate still running.
7. `skills/**` not edited: see the open question.

**Open question (the published `objectstack-ui` skill now teaches a create/edit form that is never the default):** the seat answered A (`5965506932`): PR #21535 stays non-governed and the skill text is carded as #21537 (Tier H; the three positions `SKILL.md:77`, `rules/list-views.md:29`, `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json:7` are present at the head), to ship in the same release. Right: one Tier H path would make the whole PR Tier H and hold a p1 fix behind a human approval, and the skill reaches authors only at release. Escalated correctly. The dependency it leaves, #21537 landing before the release cut, is the seat's to track and not this PR's to carry.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- objectui `applyViewItem` makes a container's first named form the console's `.form` when no item is default (`showcase_inquiry.contact` on this branch's rows): filed as objectstack-ai/objectui#11539, bare. Right: the ruling forbids a console workaround here and the rule lives in the renderer.
- Skill text: #21537, above.
- An overlay omitting `form` keeps the packaged default: consistent with name-keyed overlays, one default; noted, not filed. Right.
- The `form.name` dead read: noted and added to the PR's acceptance notes by the seat. Right (item ①.7).
- The `default_2` rename on app-crm does not reproduce at `88fb5e85a0`; its mechanism is the shared OBJECT.KEY namespace rule, already loud, and after the migration no app-crm container has a `formViews.default`. Right.

**The engine seat's hand-over (`5964198571`):** the two-default overlay reading is re-measured as one default (above); objectui's bundled expansion takes the fix at its normal spec pin bump, which the ruling says needs no card of its own. Both answered.

Every derived judgment is right, the level and the declaration match what the diff publishes, and every flag is answered or escalated to a card. This record is the contract review; the landing still waits on the two in-progress gates.
